caseNameFull: COTTRELL v. PAWCATUCK COMPANY (Formerly C. B. COTTRELL & SONS CO.) Et Al.
attorneys: Edward J. Ennis for appellant., Henry M. Canby for the Pawcatuck Company et al. and David F. Anderson for the Harris-Seybold Company et al., appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
